integrity: The two- and three-draw rarefaction identities are derived exactly from without-replacement sampling. The finite boundary is established by exhaustive enumeration of all positive abundance multisets through nine individuals, with an independent composition-based generator and exact rational replay of Hurlbert's formula.
scientific_limitations: The sharp boundary fixes both species richness and total abundance and assumes strictly positive integer species counts. If richness varies, collisions occur earlier; for continuous relative abundances there is no minimum integer sample-size question. The result concerns identifiability of abundance profiles from a pairwise concentration statistic and not the adequacy of any single ecological diversity measure.
title: Nine individuals are the sharp Simpson–rarefaction identifiability boundary
